fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive so emergency vehicles can move through without obstruction.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure to keep a clear path around each building.
• Keep the perimeter fence gate nearest the rear of the property unlocked or fitted with a breakaway latch so responders can reach the back of the structures without delay.
• Mark the location of any rear gate on the front of the property or at the driveway entrance so arriving crews know an access point exists.
• Clear a staging area near the parking zone that remains free of parked vehicles so emergency vehicles have a place to set up without blocking the single access drive.
• Thin dense vegetation along the sides and rear of the property so responders on foot can move around both structures without pushing through heavy growth.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure clear of stored items, equipment, and overgrown plants at all times.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from trees growing directly over or touching the house and any outbuildings.
• Thin trees within the cluster visible near the structure to create open gaps between tree canopies.
• Remove shrubs and low ground vegetation growing against or within a few feet of the house foundation.
• Clear overhanging branches along the driveway so vehicles, including fire trucks, can pass through without obstruction.
• Thin the mixed vegetation along the driveway edges to keep the travel lane open and visible.
• Remove ground-level vegetation growing beneath the large trees closest to the structure to reduce the path fire can travel up into the tree canopy.
• Keep the single access route free of fallen branches, overgrown shrubs, and any debris that could block emergency vehicle entry or exit.
• Separate shrub groupings from the base of any outbuildings or fences by removing or relocating plants touching those structures.
• Mow or cut back ground vegetation in areas where it connects open green space directly to vegetation growing near the house.
• Maintain visible clearance beneath the large trees closest to the house by removing low-hanging limbs up to a reasonable height from the ground.
